content:
We’ve checked out the GEEKOM A5 2027 Edition mini PC’s hardware with an unboxing and teardown in the first part of the review, and we’ve now had time to test the AMD Ryzen 7 7730U mini PC in detail with Windows 11 Pro. In this article, we will test features, run benchmarks such as PCMark 10, 3DMark, and PassMark PerformanceTest 11, test YouTube 4K and 8K video playback in Firefox, evaluate storage and network performance, and measure fan noise and power consumption of the A5 2027 Edition mini PC. Software Overview and Feature Testing The System > About menu confirms we have an A5 mini PC powered by an AMD Ryzen 7 7730U processor clocked at 2.00 GHz (base frequency) with Radeon Graphics, and equipped with 16 GB DDR4 RAM at 3200 MT/s and a 477 GB SSD preloaded with Windows 11 Pro 25H2 (Build 26200.9711).
